newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayerische LB-BMW good long-term prospect.
newsitem.headline: Bayerische LB-BMW good long-term prospect.

text.p: Analysts at Bayerische Landesbank said on Wednesday that Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW) offers good prospects as a long-term investment.
Bayerische said BMW's financial position was good and the company should be able to take advantage of synergies following its 1994 acquistion of the UK Rover Group.
The bank said existing holdings of BMW shares should at the least be held on to.
It added that Rover and BMW's aircraft engine unit BMW Rolls-Royce GmbH would make a postive contribution to the group's result by early next century.
